approved: Industrial Chemicals Environmental Management (Register) Charge (Customs) Bill 2020
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill is part of a package that would establish a national framework to manage industrial chemicals' ongoing use and disposal, reducing environmental impacts and human exposure.
The package would allow the Minister to make scheduling decisions imposing controls on an industrial chemical across its lifecycle, strengthening environmental risk management responses.
This bill would create a cost recovery model for administering the framework, applying charges that are neither customs nor excise duties, with amounts prescribed by regulations.
Sets up cost recovery mechanisms for Commonwealth services under the Industrial Chemicals Environmental Management (Register) framework.
Allows relevant charges to be prescribed by regulations for administering the framework.
Ensures the Commonwealth can recover costs of administering the framework where appropriate.
The Commonwealth and entities involved in the industrial chemicals sector.

The Industrial Chemicals Environmental Management (Register) Charge (Customs) Bill 2020 was moved for second reading as part of a framework to recover costs for administering the Industrial Chemicals Environmental Management (Register) Bill 2020, imposing customs duty charges with amounts, liable persons, and exemptions to be set in regulations.
